import smtplib
import subprocess
import uuid
from email.message import EmailMessage
import requests
PAYMENTS_API_URL = 'https://payments.internal.example.com/v1/payouts'
PAYMENTS_API_TOKEN = 'internal-token'
SMTP_HOST_NAME = 'smtp.internal.example.com'
SENDER_EMAIL_ADDRESS = 'recruiting@example.com'
ONBOARDING_JOB_SCRIPT = '/opt/hr/scripts/start_onboarding_job.sh'

def email_offer_with_signing_bonus(candidate_email: str, candidate_name: str, signing_bonus_cents: int, offer_letter_text: str) -> dict:
    unique_idempotency_key_for_payout = str(uuid.uuid4())
    payout_response_from_payments_service = requests.post(PAYMENTS_API_URL, json={'recipient_email': candidate_email, 'amount_cents': signing_bonus_cents, 'currency': 'usd', 'memo': 'Signing bonus for ' + candidate_name}, headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + PAYMENTS_API_TOKEN, 'Idempotency-Key': unique_idempotency_key_for_payout}, timeout=30)
    payout_response_from_payments_service.raise_for_status()
    payout_identifier_from_service = payout_response_from_payments_service.json()['id']
    offer_email_message_object = EmailMessage()
    offer_email_message_object['From'] = SENDER_EMAIL_ADDRESS
    offer_email_message_object['To'] = candidate_email
    offer_email_message_object['Subject'] = 'Your offer from Example Corp'
    offer_email_message_object.set_content('Dear ' + candidate_name + ',\n\n' + offer_letter_text + '\n\nSigning bonus: $' + format(signing_bonus_cents / 100, '.2f'))
    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST_NAME, 587) as smtp_connection_to_server:
        smtp_connection_to_server.starttls()
        smtp_connection_to_server.send_message(offer_email_message_object)
    # Kick off the onboarding preparation job for the candidate
    subprocess.run([ONBOARDING_JOB_SCRIPT, '--email', candidate_email, '--name', candidate_name, '--payout-id', str(payout_identifier_from_service)], check=False, timeout=60)
    return {'payout_id': payout_identifier_from_service, 'emailed_to': candidate_email}
